title: My House
text:
This is my house. It is small and yellow. There is a red door and two windows. In the living room, there is a big sofa and a table. The sofa is soft and brown.

My bedroom is upstairs. There is a bed, a lamp and a wardrobe. The lamp is next to the bed. I like my room because it is very bright in the morning.

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the house?
What is the lamp probably for?

vocabulary.definition: a long, soft seat for two or more people
on a higher floor of a building

paragraph_translations: To jest mój dom. Jest mały i żółty. Są czerwone drzwi i dwa okna. W salonie jest duża sofa i stół. Sofa jest miękka i brązowa.
Moja sypialnia jest na górze. Jest tam łóżko, lampa i szafa. Lampa jest obok łóżka. Lubię mój pokój, bo rano jest bardzo jasno.
